literal_meaning: বারবার খাটুনি বা কঠোর শ্রমের পুনরাবৃত্তি
figurative_meaning_en: a lot of / considerable hard work
example_sentences_in_english: He has broken his body from all the hard toil.
This job will require a lot of hard work.
note: The idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on diligence in Bengali agrarian and labor-intensive lifestyles.
